presentation.label: Two-operator FM
presentation.summary: Two-operator FM with a dedicated track machine, one to four voices, chords and glide.
presentation.overview: FM SYNTH provides one to four paraphonic FM voices through the stock AMP and effects. Version 0.1.4 is the author's Octatrick 2.21 line: step and scene locks on every FM control, LFOs and scenes on the AMP envelope, LFO pitch depth as on FLEX, a selection guard and voice cap per Part, chords on the chromatic keys that keep their notes with a scale, and the first chord after power-on kept as a chord. Its bundled scale quantizer follows the scale on FM SYNTH tracks; MIDI tracks are Scale Quantizer's. Emulator checks pass; the author reports the TEST7 image (before the LFO SETUP names hook came back) working on his MKI (30 October 2026) and this cut's image is not yet reported; it installs with a card build only.
highlights: Dedicated machine chooser entry; no sample required.
Pitch, ratio, index, fine tuning, feedback and index decay on SRC.
One to four paraphonic voices, chord shapes and inversions.
Chromatic playing, MIDI, legato and privately bundled scale/glide controls for FM tracks.
usage: Open a disposable project with FM Synth firmware. Select an audio track, hold FUNC and press SRC, select FM SYNTH with UP/DOWN and press YES. No sample is required.
Press SRC. Set RATO to 1 and turn INDX from 0 upwards to hear a sine tone acquire FM harmonics. PTCH transposes it; FINE tunes it in cents; FDBK adds feedback; DEC shortens the modulation envelope.
Place a trig and press PLAY. In SRC SETUP (FUNC+SRC) set VOIC to 2–4 and CHRD to a chord if wanted. AMP ATK/HOLD/REL shape the gain envelope; FUNC+AMP exposes LEG.
Press STOP twice to silence the voice. To return to a sample machine, hold FUNC and press SRC, select FLEX or STATIC and press YES; assign the desired sample in the normal way.

access.location: Audio track > FUNC+SRC > FM SYNTH (VOIC and CHRD in SRC SETUP); SRC for tone, FUNC+AMP for LEG; PROJECT > CONTROL > SEQUENCER for the scale.

controls.name: PTCH
controls.doc: SRC A: raw 64 is 0 semitones; raw 0–127 gives −64…+63. Scale and chromatic edits can constrain pitch.

controls.name: RATO
controls.doc: SRC B: raw>>2 selects 32 modulation ratios from 0.25 to 16; default raw 12 gives ratio 1.

controls.name: INDX
controls.doc: SRC C: FM modulation depth, raw 0–127. Zero produces the unmodulated carrier.

controls.name: FINE
controls.doc: SRC D: raw 64 is 0 cents; raw 0–127 gives −64…+63 cents.

controls.name: FDBK
controls.doc: SRC E: modulation-operator feedback, raw 0–127. Extreme feedback can be bright and alias.

controls.name: DEC
controls.doc: SRC F: modulation-index decay. Default raw 40 displays about 199 ms. This is separate from the AMP gain envelope.

controls.name: VOIC
controls.doc: LFO C: effective voice count 1–4. Values outside 1–4, including raw 0, normalize to one voice. Initial inherited LFO value displays one; four voices share the track filter and AMP.

controls.name: CHRD
controls.doc: LFO F: 32 chord shapes with four inversions each, encoded as shape<<2 | inversion. ---- uses individual played/recorded notes.

controls.name: LEG
controls.doc: FUNC+AMP F: OFF retriggers, MONO preserves one envelope across overlapping keys, POLY enables paraphonic legato. Ordinary sample tracks expose OFF/MONO.

controls.name: SCALE
controls.doc: OFF restores stock pitch behavior; select a scale to constrain an FM SYNTH track's PTCH edits, locks and chromatic keys.

controls.name: ROOT
controls.doc: Root of the scale and chromatic keyboard. Ignored with SCALE OFF.

controls.name: GLIDE
controls.doc: OFF or 1–127 slide time; the track LEG setting controls legato.

limitations: Parts store stock FLEX kind 1 plus FM/1 in unused NEIGHBOR control bytes. A stock build reads the track as FLEX; it does not synthesize FM. Choose stock explicitly before downgrading.
VOIC and CHRD sit in the PLAYBACK SETUP page's LOOP and SLIC boxes; LFOs and scenes reach them (PMTR VOIC / CHRD), and they are latched at a note's START.
A Part holds at most two FM SYNTH tracks; the voices are capped so the Part stays within the CPU budget (the VOIC shown is the Part's). A choice past the limit is refused with a message.
An LFO on PTCH moves the pitch 0.2 semitone per unit of depth, as on FLEX. FLEX's PTCH stops at +-12.8 semitones; an FM SYNTH track's range goes further.

The matching quantizer is bundled privately because the engine shares its mailbox and fixed scale accessor. With FM Synth alone, MIDI tracks are not quantized, and on STATIC / FLEX tracks the PTCH knob, PTCH locks and chromatic keys step through the scale but a trig's PTCH is not snapped as it plays, and the chromatic keyboard marks the key pressed, not the note sounded: those are Scale Quantizer's, which is a declared conflict with FM Synth (both carry the same quantizer source and would patch the same sites).

A project saved with Scale Quantizer or Octatrick (#SEQUENCER_AUDIO_SCALE_OFF) keeps those tracks out of the scale under FM Synth, FM SYNTH tracks included; FM Synth has no per-track rows to change it.

Cannot combine with Analog BD, whose native hooks overlap this module's, or with Scale Quantizer: both carry the same quantizer source and would patch the same sites, and a module may not hook into another module's code, rows, tables or files (the owner, #555, 31 October 2026).
About 12 dB louder than 0.1.2 at identical mixer settings (6 dB of headroom instead of 18); AMP VOL 0 is the reference and VOL above it can clip a full-scale voice.
Card builds only: the Octatrack base's USB package for this version cannot be built yet (DRAM regions and generated includes; TESTING.md).

Emulator-checked (boot, the machine list, chords at VOIC 4 with a scale, the first chord after power-on, SEQUENCER rows, LFO SETUP names, the level of an FM SYNTH track unchanged by a sample loaded into its slot). The author reports this cut's image (TEST9) working on his MKI on 1 November 2026, its test sheet passing (the optional step not confirmed; TESTING.md), and the TEST7 image (this cut before the LFO SETUP names hook came back and before the slot GAIN fix) on 30 October 2026 (TESTING.md). Play time and readings were not recorded; external MIDI traffic, maximum loads and hardware timing are not measured.

storage.label: Shared audio arena reservation
storage.conditions: Shared native platform reservation of 1,707 × 6,144-byte pages. This is not the exact incremental FM memory cost: complete code/state/table/stack/padding and peak lifetime accounting remains pending.

processing.label: ColdFire synthesis
processing.conditions: CF computes each FM sample and up to four voices per track. Parameter modulation, MIDI, mode changes and maximum eight-track loads have not been priced.

impact.conditions: Estimates for eight FM tracks with up to four voices each; no measured comparison or real-time guarantee.

cpu.rationale: Per-sample two-operator FM and multiple voice/envelope/chord/glide paths execute on ColdFire.

dsp.rationale: No new DSP algorithm; generated audio passes through existing stock source, AMP and effect processing.

memory.rationale: The native platform reserves a shared 10 MiB audio arena plus synth/quantizer state and page clones.

tests.summary: Experimental 0.1.4 (the author's octatrick 2.21): the native card build boots and plays in the emulator; chords on the chromatic keys at VOIC 4 with a scale keep their notes on every repeat, the first chord after power-on in a saved project is a chord, and an FM SYNTH track's level is unchanged by a sample loaded into its slot. The author reports this cut's image (TEST9, upgrade file 296f9c0e..., MAIN cd7c72c8...) working on his MKI on 1 November 2026, its test sheet passing (the optional step not confirmed; TESTING.md), and the TEST7 image (MAIN 265308da..., this cut before the LFO SETUP names hook came back and before the slot GAIN fix) on 30 October 2026 (TESTING.md); the TEST4 report (26 October 2026) was for the 2.20 cut. See TESTING.md.
